يشتعلان (form VIII)
# يَشْتَعِلَانِ (yaštaʕilāni) /jaʃ.ta.ʕi.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# يُشْتَعَلَانِ (yuštaʕalāni) /juʃ.ta.ʕa.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
